The company was founded in 1987 as a small regional distributor and has since grown to serve customers in eleven countries. Its product catalogue covers fasteners, hydraulic fittings, bearings, seals and a range of maintenance consumables. Orders placed before two in the afternoon are usually dispatched the same day from the main warehouse, and a second distribution centre opened last year to shorten delivery times in the northern region. The firm publishes an annual sustainability report describing its packaging reduction programme, its transition to electric delivery vans and its work with local training colleges. Customer support is available by phone and email during business hours, and a self-service portal lets account holders download invoices, track shipments and manage delivery addresses. The quality team runs incoming inspection on all batches from new suppliers and keeps certificates of conformity on file for at least seven years. Pricing is reviewed quarterly, and volume discounts are available for framework agreements of more than twelve months.
